items.exampleEn: We sit in the first row.

items.exampleZh: 她有一個粉紅色的包包。

items.exampleEn: Is this sentence true or false?
items.exampleZh: 這個句子是對的還是錯的？

items.sentenceEn: Excellent work! Everyone did very well.
items.sentenceZh: 做得非常好！大家都表現得很好。

items.audioEn: The fish here is terrible, but the cake is excellent.
items.audioZh: 這裡的魚很難吃，但蛋糕非常好吃。

items.sentenceEn: Please sit in the second row.
The old man has gray hair and brown eyes.
items.sentenceZh: 那位老先生有灰色的頭髮和棕色的眼睛。

items.stemEn: Three and four is eight. That is not ____.
items.stemZh: 三加四等於八，這不正確。

items.passageEn: Today we had a test in class. I sat in the front row. There were ten true or false questions. I got nine correct answers, so my teacher said, "Excellent!" After school, the sky was gray, and the rain was terrible. My pink umbrella was at home.
items.passageZh: 今天我們在課堂上考試，我坐在第一排。考卷有十題是非題，我答對九題，所以老師說：「非常好！」放學後天空灰濛濛的，雨下得很大。我的粉紅色雨傘卻放在家裡。

rubricZh: 「正確的」可用 correct 或 right
否定可用 is not、isn't 等

items.instructionZh: 用 terrible 造一個句子，說說很糟的天氣、食物或一天。
referenceEn: I had a terrible day at work.
rubricZh: terrible 放在 be 動詞後面或名詞前面（例如 was terrible、a terrible day）
